name: hindsight
title: Hindsight
description: Long-term memory for AI agents. Agents retain, recall and reflect on what they learn through a REST API or MCP (Claude Code, Cursor and others), with a web UI to browse memory banks. Uses an LLM of your choice, such as an Anthropic API key; embeddings run locally.

defaultEnv.label: LLM Provider
defaultEnv.description: Who runs the model Hindsight uses to extract, consolidate and reflect on memories. Embeddings and reranking run locally either way.

options.label: None: store and search raw text, no fact extraction

defaultEnv.label: LLM API Key
defaultEnv.description: API key for the provider above, e.g. an Anthropic key (sk-ant-…). Leave empty for a local runtime such as Ollama.

defaultEnv.label: LLM Model
defaultEnv.description: Model name. Empty uses the provider's default (claude-haiku-4-5 for Anthropic).

defaultEnv.label: LLM Base URL
defaultEnv.description: Only for Ollama, LM Studio or an OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. http://ollama.example.lan:11434/v1. Empty for hosted providers.

defaultEnv.label: Agent API Key
defaultEnv.description: Bearer key agents send to the REST API (/v1/) and MCP endpoint (/mcp/<bank>/). Generated for you; find it later under this app's configuration.

defaultEnv.label: Database Password
defaultEnv.description: Password for the internal Postgres database. Generated for you.
